v12: Lookup-sheet integrity pass. (1) Used_In_Workbook recomputed from actual use across all three lookup sheets — 7 SDG Goal Lookup flags said "No" while the goal was in use (SDG-1 x13, SDG-3 x1, SDG-5 x4, SDG-7 x6, SDG-8 x16, SDG-9 x12, SDG-10 x14); GBF Target Lookup was already correct. (2) The 28-row "KEY SDG BIODIVERSITY TARGETS" block was removed from SDG Goal Lookup: it duplicated the SDG Target Lookup, carried paraphrased text in a column named Full_Text_Official, and had no Official_Link. The two codes held only there, SDG-4.7 and SDG-16.4, were added to SDG Target Lookup with official UN wording and links (now 129 rows). (3) Four records held SDG codes in GBF_Targets_Clean (IND-E-051 SDG-3; IND-J-061 SDG-15.5; IND-J-065 SDG-11.7; IND-B-163 SDG-13); these were moved to SDG_Goals_Clean / SDG_Target_Code, which were added to the EIF, JNCC and EEA sheets (the columns already existed on SDG Indicators and BIP Indicators). NOTE FOR FUTURE EDITS: the new columns were APPENDED, not inserted. openpyxl insert_cols moves cell values but leaves worksheet-level hyperlinks anchored to the old coordinate, which silently duplicated the Source_URL of JNCC rows 15, 46 and 64 into the new column on a first attempt. Cells S15/S46/S64 on the JNCC sheet are the only hyperlinks in the workbook — do not use insert_cols on that sheet. HISTORY: v12 was first written 2026-09-16 and was lost when an older cloud copy overwrote the local file overnight; re-applied 2026-09-17 from the same script. STILL OPEN: SDG Target Lookup holds 129 of the 169 official targets; SDG-3, SDG-4, SDG-16 and SDG-5.1-5.6 remain absent by scope, and SDG-11.c is an unexplained singleton gap. SDG cross-references for the ~200 non-SDG-sheet records that name SDGs only in Policy_Goal prose remain uncurated.

v13: Housekeeping. (1) Source_Organisation removed from EEA Biodiversity Indicators — all 62 rows held the identical constant "European Environment Agency (EEA)", which Indicator Framework already records as the IFW-09 Lead_Organisation. The column is RETAINED on IPBES Indicators (30 distinct custodians) and CBD GBF Indicators (3), where it carries real per-record information; do not remove it there by analogy. No code, protocol or dashboard read the column. (2) Data Dictionary corrections: five rows named sheets that do not exist ("Biodiversity Indicators", "JNCC UK Biodiversity Indic" x3, "State of Nature 2023") and have been re-pointed at the real sheet names; Policy_Links (present on all nine framework sheets) and the four undocumented SDG Target Lookup columns are now documented. (3) Column widths and row heights recomputed across all 18 sheets. Widths were badly mismatched to content — on the EEA sheet Climate_Score was 50 characters wide for a single digit while Climate_Rationale was 16 wide for text up to 466 characters. Widths are now set from the 90th percentile of content length, clamped to 9-55; row heights re-estimated against the new widths (14.4pt per wrapped line, capped at 160pt); stale dimension entries removed (SDG Goal Lookup carried row heights for 28 rows deleted in v12, and width entries for columns F, G and I on a five-column sheet). STILL OPEN (needs a decision, not yet actioned): the Data Dictionary documents ten columns that no longer exist on any sheet — Reporting_Status, Indicator_Role, Target_Benchmark, CCC_Key_Indicator, Measure_Component, Assessment_Year, Cross_Sheet_Note, BIP_Status, SDG_Theme, SDG_Target. Only SDG_Theme is marked "REMOVED in v5"; the rest read as current. They should either be annotated the same way or deleted.

v14: Data Dictionary rebuilt from the live schema. It previously accreted history — old rows were kept and new ones appended — so it documented ten columns that no longer existed anywhere (Reporting_Status, Indicator_Role, Target_Benchmark, CCC_Key_Indicator, Measure_Component, Assessment_Year, Cross_Sheet_Note, BIP_Status, SDG_Theme, SDG_Target) alongside "data gaps audit" and "v5 additions" marker blocks. All removed. The sheet now carries exactly one row per column that exists today, grouped by sheet: 15 rows for the columns common to all nine framework sheets, 9 for framework-specific columns with an exhaustive sheet list, then one block per remaining sheet. NEW CONVENTION, stated in row 2 of the sheet: this dictionary documents the current version only and is maintained IN PLACE — when a column is added, renamed, re-scoped or removed, edit or delete its row; do not append a row recording the change. Version history belongs here in the Changelog. Also: freeze panes corrected from A50 (which froze the first 49 rows) to A2, and two stale merged ranges removed — A43:F43 and A57:F57 survived the row deletion and silently masked columns B-F on those rows, dropping the Column_Name for Indicator Framework.Official_Link and SDG Goal Lookup.Used_In_Workbook until they were rewritten. NOTE FOR FUTURE EDITS: openpyxl writes to a merged cell are silently lost on save. Unmerge before rewriting any sheet, and verify documented columns against the live headers afterwards.

v15: Indicator Framework — Policy_Goal_Summary renamed Policy_Purpose and revalued from each framework's own primary documentation. The former values were semicolon-delimited lists of policy instruments rather than summaries, and several had absorbed indicator-level detail through aggregation of the Policy_Goal field: IFW-02 ended "Minimise climate change impacts on biodiversity (GBF-T8)" and IFW-07 read "GBF Goal A and Targets 2, 8, 11; SDG 15.5", neither of which described the framework. IFW-04 implied State of Nature reports against the GBF, which it does not — it is an independent NGO-led assessment with no statutory targets. New values are 565-808 characters of prose covering purpose and policy range, sourced and reviewed in outputs_other/policy_goal_summary_review/. New column Key_Instruments holds bracketed governance codes ONLY (no names) for the instruments and organisations named in Policy_Purpose — normally the body creating, hosting or using the framework, its statutory basis where it has one, and the key policies or international instruments it informs. All 34 codes were validated against the governance registry before writing. It was APPENDED, not inserted (see the v12 note on insert_cols and hyperlinks). Column widths and row heights for the sheet were refitted to the longer text, cap raised to 300pt for this sheet only. Data Dictionary updated IN PLACE per the v14 convention. NOT CHANGED, by decision: Source_Framework for IFW-09 still reads "EEA Biodiversity Strategy Indicators" although the EEA publishes no set under that title. MEDIUM CONFIDENCE: the IFW-01 clause stating that the OEP scrutinises the EIP progress report is well established but was not found on the EIF pages themselves.

This replaces the algorithmic truncation the export prototype had been deriving on the fly, which cut mid-phrase ("Take urgent and significant action to reduce the degradation of natural…").
